context: Windows v1.2.1 -> v1.3.0 public updater post-install validation
rootCause: Validator looked under {app}\\router_gateway while installer intentionally installs to {app}\\app\\router_gateway and WPF AppContext.BaseDirectory is {app}\\app.
prevention: Post-install validation now derives the router data path from the executable directory contract ({InstallLocation}\\app\\router_gateway).
